name: Statue
promptTemplate: Create a detailed neoclassical Greek white Carrara marble statue honoring the uploaded image. If the image has a person, depict the person in the statue as a powerful allegorical figure in motion, with flowing garments, a confident pose, and a serious expression. If it is not a person, do not add a person. Include elements from the photo to give the statue personality and non-generic historical artifacts using only the subject details explicitly provided for this request. Set in a museum hall. Photorealistic with medium depth of field, natural perspective, and warm museum lighting casting dramatic, realistic shadows.
promptHints: Photo of a person or pet in the foreground
